color.description: A colour with alpha, as normalised numbers.

alpha.description: Opacity, 0.0 transparent to 1.0 opaque (straight, not premultiplied).

c.description: Up to four colour components in the order `mode` gives; unused ones are 0. Nominal range 0.0 to 1.0; a 32-bit float document may hold values outside it.

color_mode.description: A colour model. Rgb, Indexed, Multichannel: components are red, green, blue. Grayscale, Bitmap, Duotone: one component, 0.0 black to 1.0 white. Cmyk: cyan, magenta, yellow, black as INK amounts, 0.0 no ink to 1.0 full ink. Lab: lightness L*/100, then (a* + 128)/255 and (b* + 128)/255.

description: An extra channel: a saved selection (alpha channel), a spot colour, or the Quick Mask. One gray value per pixel: 1.0 selected / full ink, 0.0 masked / no ink.

color.description: The overlay colour used when the channel is shown over the image.

indicates.description: Whether the overlay colour marks the masked (black) or the selected (white) areas.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's shape. Always 1 in raster-layers/1.

solidity.description: 0.0 to 1.0: how opaque the ink is in a preview.

spot.description: Set for a spot colour channel. Null: an alpha channel.

surface.description: The `core.raster.surface` node holding the channel's pixels (one channel, document coordinates).
